name: Present Simple
description: Habits, routines, facts and repeated actions.
examples: I love you.
He loves it.

name: Present Continuous
description: Actions happening now or around the current period.
examples: I am loving this moment.
She is reading a book.

name: Present Perfect
description: Past actions connected with the present or unfinished time periods.
examples: I have loved this place for years.
He has finished his work.

name: Present Perfect Continuous
description: An activity that started in the past and continues or has a visible recent result.
examples: I have been waiting for you.
She has been studying all day.

name: Past Simple
examples: I loved the movie.
He went home yesterday.

name: Past Continuous
description: An action that was in progress at a particular past time.
examples: I was watching TV.
They were working at that time.

name: Past Perfect
description: An action completed before another past action.
examples: I had finished the report before lunch.
She had left when I arrived.

name: Past Perfect Continuous
description: An activity that continued up to a point in the past.
examples: I had been waiting for an hour.
They had been working since morning.

name: Future Simple
examples: I will love you forever.
He will call you tomorrow.

name: Future Continuous
description: An action that will be in progress at a future time.
examples: I will be working tomorrow morning.
She will be traveling this time next week.

name: Future Perfect
description: An action that will be completed before a future point.
examples: I will have finished the report by Friday.
He will have arrived by then.

name: Future Perfect Continuous
description: An activity continuing up to a future point.
examples: I will have been working here for a year by June.
She will have been studying for three hours by noon.
